duration.text: The English at Dalian University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2708 USD/per year ￥ 19500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: Applicants must 1. Hold a high school degree, 2. Be in good health 3. Over the age of 18 4. Have passed Chinese level of HSK6 or above (There are no requirements for those who applied for courses taught in English)
